title: Baytex Energy: The Business of Oil & Gas - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 57]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: This is Matt Reustle and today we’re breaking down Baytex Energy.
reader_summary.overview: This is Matt Reustle and today we’re breaking down Baytex Energy. With oil prices hovering over $100 a barrel, we thought it was a particularly good time to revisit this sector. The 80,000 barrel a day producer certainly isn’t a household name.

key_points.text: And with a market cap just north of $3 billion, it’s far from a mega-cap.
But Baytex has production in five different operating areas spanning across the US and Canada.
Some of those fields are mature, some are emerging.
